limitations.quote: // Reuse the final zero as the first bit of a possible next match.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but changed the post-match transitions: an invalid cycle now goes to `s1_d0` and a valid one goes to `s2_d01`, whereas the original and reference designs return to `idle` in both cases.
The exhaustive test used a sliding window that assumed overlapping matches, so it exercised the disputed transitions but treated the regression as correct.
